timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Cell walls are a structure that are found in plants and it's the outermost structure surrounding a plant cell.
One of the jobs of a cell wall is to maintain the shape of the cell.
In plant cells, cell walls are filled with cellulose.
And cellulose is a rigid structure that provides protection for the cell from the external environment.
Not only is the cell wall in a plant protecting the cell from the external environment, it's also holding the structure of the internal environment.
Cells tend to contain a lot of water.
And so what this cell wall does is it's kind of like a container to hold all the contents of the plant cell in.
